stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 14 hours and pipe B can fill it in 15 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the cistern? (2 decimal places, in hours.)
solutionMarkdown: A's rate $= 1/14$ of the cistern per hour, B's rate $= 1/15$. Combined rate $= 1/14 + 1/15 = 0.1381$ per hour. Time together $= \dfrac{1}{1/14+1/15} = 7.24$ hours.
